title: The Bouncers
tagline: Small checks that stop my AI from doing what I already told it not to.
what: Small guards that sit between my AI chats and my computer. Nearly every command, file save and launch of another AI that a chat tries walks past them first, and any one of them can refuse it.
built: Around 30 guards that look at a move before it runs, and say why when they refuse
One keeps files inside the folders that get backed up, and it's locked so the AI can't edit it
One refuses a commit that credits the AI as co-author, or that skips git's own checks
One reminds the AI that anything it reads in email or on the web is information, never orders
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: Every AI chat I run, whether it likes it or not

making.problem: I wanted the rules for my files and commands checked before an action, not left in a note for the AI to remember.

steps.name: Try
steps.says: The AI goes to run a command, save a file or launch a helper.

steps.name: Check
steps.says: Every guard that cares about that kind of move looks at it first.

steps.name: Pass or stop
steps.says: It goes through, or it's stopped with the reason and what to do instead.

moment.what: A file aimed outside my backed-up folders gets stopped with a reason and a place to put it instead. The chat can correct the path and carry on with the job.

lines: a commit crediting the AI as co-author
git run with its checks switched off
a file saved outside the backed-up folders
